# Block whitespace-only required details before saving

## What & Why
The current regression coverage checks truly empty fields, but users can also submit spaces in required answer and opportunity fields. Treating whitespace as missing must remain consistent with the visible guidance and accessibility wiring.

## Done looks like
- Whitespace-only answer title and content remain blocked with their field-specific messages
- Whitespace-only opportunity company and role remain blocked with their field-specific messages
- aria-invalid and aria-describedby continue to identify the visible messages
